verdicts.reason: Both moved the orange divider so it now floats above the eyebrow, though in the original it sat under the headline. Both also leave a big dead gap between the headline and the body copy, and both shrink the legal line until it is unreadable. A at least keeps the eyebrow tight to the headline and the CTA close to its copy, as the original does. B pulls the eyebrow away from the headline and pushes the CTA down against the fine print, so the groups fall apart and the spacing looks arbitrary.
